incident.definition: An unplanned interruption to an IT service or reduction in the quality of an IT service.

severity.definition: The extent of impact that an incident has on the business or technical system.

sla.definition: Service Level Agreement - contractually committed target time to resolve an incident.

sla_breach.definition: An incident whose actual resolution time exceeded the agreed SLA target.

mttr.definition: Mean Time to Resolve - the average duration from incident creation to incident resolution in minutes or hours.

recurring_incident.definition: An incident that shares structural patterns, application footprints, and underlying root causes with past incidents.

root_cause.definition: The fundamental cause or underlying factor that triggered the incident.

application.definition: A business software system or infrastructure platform.

service.definition: A specific technical component or microservice belonging to an application.

fingerprint.definition: A signature composed of system tokens (app, service, error signature) representing a recurring failure pattern.
